one_paragraph: The fixture-complete manifest closed the HQ197 blocker exactly as predicted. The accepted six-file R7 court collects to exactly 55 and passes 55/55 on two consecutive runs with exit code 0, against the repaired candidate with no production edit in this lane. The candidate broker court passes 20/20, and nine independent exercises of the commissioned properties all pass, including that the byte limiter enforces its ceiling by shortening the request and returning end-of-stream rather than by raising through pyreadstat's callback. The C4 closure recomputes to 21 imported modules at the freeze and 22 at the candidate, a delta of exactly the broker, with zero raw source path strings reaching pyreadstat anywhere in the closure and exactly one governed physical open per scope confirmed empirically over 100 decode cycles.

why_this_disposition.because: The court reached 55/55 on both required runs with exit code 0. There were no failures, so nothing was retried.
The candidate broker court passed 20/20 with exit code 0, and all nine independent property exercises passed.

The commissioned manifest materialized every fixture the court needed. Both previously-missing paths were confirmed PRESENT on disk before collection, so the 55/55 is a genuine execution result and not a collection artefact.

Every commissioned proof obligation was met: exact denominator 55, two clean runs, broker courts passing, independent property exercises passing, and a closure proof that is recomputed rather than asserted and is falsifiable via a positive control.
